segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I\IINA: Hi, George! Glad you're back. Loads of people have phoned you.

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: Really?

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: I felt just like your secretary!

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: Sorry! I went into the library this afternoon to have a look at a newspaper and I came across something really interesting.

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: What? A book?

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: No, a brochure from a summer festival - mainly Spanish music. Look, I've got it here.

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: Spanish music? I really love the guitar. Let's have a look. So what's this group 'Guitarrini'?

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: They're really good. They had a videQwith all the highlightsof the festival at a stand in the lobby to the library, so I heard them. They play fantastic instruments- drums and flutes and old kinds of guitars. I've never heard anything like it before.

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: Sounds great.

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: Okay. Shall we go then? Spoil ourselves?

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: Yes, let's.

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: The only problem is there aren't any cheap seats ... it's all one price.

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: Well, in that case we could sit right at the front-we'd have a really good view.

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: Yeah, though I think that if you sit at the back you can actually hear the whole thing better.

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: Yes. Anyway we can decide when we get there.

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: So will you fill in the form or shall I?

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: I'll do it. Name: George O'Neill. Address: 48 North Avenue, Westsea. Do you rememberour new postcode?Still can't rememberit.

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: Just a minute - I've got it written down here. WS6 2YH. Do you need the phone too?

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: Please. I'm really bad at numbers.

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: 01674 553242. So, let's book two tickets for Guitarrini.

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: Okay. If you're sure £7.50 each is all right. How do you feel about the singer?

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: I haven't quite decided. But I've noticed something on the booking form that might just persuade me!

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: What's that then?

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: Free refreshments!

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: Really?

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: Yes, look here. Sunday 17th of June. Singer, ticket £6.00 includes drinks in the garden. --

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: Sounds like a bargain to me!

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: Yes, let's book two tickets for that. So, what else? I'm feeling quite keen now! How about the pianist on the 22nd of June?

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: Anna Ventura? I've just rememberedthat's my evening class night.

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: That's okay. I'll just have to go on my own - but we can go to the Spanish dance and guitar concert together, can't we?

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: Yes- I'm sure Tom and Kieran would enjoy that too. Good heavens- £10.50 a ticket! I can see we're going to have to go without food for the QB rest of the week we'll need to book four!

segments.speaker: NINA
segments.en: Wish we were students- look! Children, Students and Senior Citizens get a 50% discount on everything.

segments.speaker: GEORGE
segments.en: If only!
